@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"math"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTracingConfigValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{-0.1, 1.1, math.NaN()} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.SamplingRatio = ratio
+		require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1")
+	}
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{0, 0.5, 1} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.SamplingRatio = ratio
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+	for _, option := range []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage,
+		TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorB3Multi, TracingPropagatorJaeger,
+		TracingPropagatorXRay, TracingPropagatorOTTrace, TracingPropagatorNone} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.Propagators = []TracingPropagator{option}
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+	cfg := Default().Tracing
+	cfg.Propagators = []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorBaggage, "unknown"}
+	require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "invalid propagator option: unknown")
+}
+
+func TestTracingConfigLoad(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name, yaml, wantErr string
+		wantRatio           float64
+		wantPropagators     []TracingPropagator
+	}{
+		{name: "defaults", yaml: "tracing:\n  enabled: true\n", wantRatio: 1,
+			wantPropagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}},
+		{name: "custom", yaml: "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3, jaeger]\n",
+			wantRatio: 0.5, wantPropagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorJaeger}},
+		{name: "invalid ratio", yaml: "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 2\n", wantErr: "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{name: "invalid propagator", yaml: "tracing:\n  propagators: [invalid]\n", wantErr: "invalid propagator option: invalid"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(tt.yaml), 0600))
+			result, err := Load(path)
+			if tt.wantErr != "" {
+				require.EqualError(t, err, tt.wantErr)
+				return
+			}
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.wantRatio, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.wantPropagators, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+		})
+	}
+}

+// NewPropagator constructs the configured composite context propagator.
+func NewPropagator(configured []config.TracingPropagator) propagation.TextMapPropagator {
+	for _, name := range configured {
+		if name == config.TracingPropagatorNone {
+			return propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator()
+		}
+	}
+	propagators := make([]propagation.TextMapPropagator, 0, len(configured))
+	for _, name := range configured {
+		switch name {
+		case config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext:
+			propagators = append(propagators, propagation.TraceContext{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorBaggage:
+			propagators = append(propagators, propagation.Baggage{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorB3:
+			propagators = append(propagators, b3.New(b3.WithInjectEncoding(b3.B3SingleHeader)))
+		case config.TracingPropagatorB3Multi:
+			propagators = append(propagators, b3.New(b3.WithInjectEncoding(b3.B3MultipleHeader)))
+		case config.TracingPropagatorJaeger:
+			propagators = append(propagators, jaegerprop.Jaeger{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorXRay:
+			propagators = append(propagators, xray.Propagator{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorOTTrace:
+			propagators = append(propagators, ot.OT{})
+		}
+	}
+	return propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(propagators...)
+}

+package config
+
+import (
+	"math"

+
+func TestTracingConfigValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{-0.1, 1.1, math.NaN()} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.SamplingRatio = ratio
+		require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1")
+	}
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{0, 0.5, 1} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.SamplingRatio = ratio
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+	for _, option := range []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage,
+		TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorB3Multi, TracingPropagatorJaeger,
+		TracingPropagatorXRay, TracingPropagatorOTTrace, TracingPropagatorNone} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.Propagators = []TracingPropagator{option}
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+	cfg := Default().Tracing
+	cfg.Propagators = []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorBaggage, "unknown"}
+	require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "invalid propagator option: unknown")
+}
+
+func TestTracingConfigLoad(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name, yaml, wantErr string
+		wantRatio           float64
+		wantPropagators     []TracingPropagator
+	}{
+		{name: "defaults", yaml: "tracing:\n  enabled: true\n", wantRatio: 1,
+			wantPropagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}},
+		{name: "custom", yaml: "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3, jaeger]\n",
+			wantRatio: 0.5, wantPropagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorJaeger}},
+		{name: "invalid ratio", yaml: "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 2\n", wantErr: "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{name: "invalid propagator", yaml: "tracing:\n  propagators: [invalid]\n", wantErr: "invalid propagator option: invalid"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(tt.yaml), 0600))
+			result, err := Load(path)
+			if tt.wantErr != "" {
+				require.EqualError(t, err, tt.wantErr)
+				return
+			}
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.wantRatio, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.wantPropagators, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+		})
+	}
+}

+// NewPropagator constructs the configured composite context propagator.
+func NewPropagator(configured []config.TracingPropagator) propagation.TextMapPropagator {
+	for _, name := range configured {
+		if name == config.TracingPropagatorNone {
+			return propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator()
+		}
+	}
+	propagators := make([]propagation.TextMapPropagator, 0, len(configured))
+	for _, name := range configured {
+		switch name {
+		case config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext:
+			propagators = append(propagators, propagation.TraceContext{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorBaggage:
+			propagators = append(propagators, propagation.Baggage{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorB3:
+			propagators = append(propagators, b3.New(b3.WithInjectEncoding(b3.B3SingleHeader)))
+		case config.TracingPropagatorB3Multi:
+			propagators = append(propagators, b3.New(b3.WithInjectEncoding(b3.B3MultipleHeader)))
+		case config.TracingPropagatorJaeger:
+			propagators = append(propagators, jaegerprop.Jaeger{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorXRay:
+			propagators = append(propagators, xray.Propagator{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorOTTrace:
+			propagators = append(propagators, ot.OT{})
+		}
+	}
+	return propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(propagators...)
+}
